svg.title: The simulated fly brain at rest, with flyvis's eyes: a dark disk looms at the left eye, the left looming detectors LC4 and LPLC2 light up over the resting activity, and the left giant fiber fires
svg.text: The resting brain sees a looming disk, and its escape neuron fires
one fly: every neuron firing in each 80 ms lit; the left eye's looming detectors ringed
spikes per second, mean of 8 flies
